place.source_title: Pier-park stage canopy, Polk Bros Park (2016)

brief: A 2016 open-air stage: a raised stage under a tensioned white canopy roof on a steel frame, facing a lawn by the lake. One photo. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Lake Stage (Polk Bros Park, Navy Pier, 2016): a raised open stage under a white tensioned canopy on a steel truss, speaker masts either side, facing a sloped lawn where people sit on blankets; the lake, a lighthouse and harbour behind

why.note: free outdoor stages anchor lakefront parks: the lawn is the seating
